plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Computer-Science-and-Software-Engineering-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (source file titled 'CSSE Degree Map 2022-2023.docx'; printed footer 'Last updated: 09/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total; under its printed rule ('All classes are 5 credits unless followed by a parenthesis with a number, indicating the number of credits') every slot is 5 credits (the only parentheticals printed in the table are the designations (C), (W) and (RSN), not credit numbers), so each quarter sums to 15 and the plan to 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. Two printed cells combine a lecture and its skills lab in one 5-credit slot and are folded into the lecture entry with the combination disclosed on the course title: 'CSS 142 + CSSSKL 142' (Year 1 Winter), 'CSS 143 + CSSSKL 143' (Year 1 Spring), and 'CSS 342 ... and CSSSKL 342' (Year 3 Autumn). CSS 497 appears twice because the map prints 'CSS 497: Capstone (1 of 2)' in Year 4 Winter and 'CSS 497: Capstone (2 of 2)' in Year 4 Spring; allow_repeated_courses is set for this printed repeat only. Diamond markers printed on the map are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain): the filled diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major' and the open diamond means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core'. Application-prerequisite slots as printed: B WRIT 134, STMATH 124, CSS 142 + CSSSKL 142, STMATH 125, CSS 143 + CSSSKL 143 and B WRIT 135. The Year 2 Autumn statistics slot prints three options (BIS 215, B BUS 215, B MATH 215) and the designation (RSN); the options are listed on the slot exactly as printed. Generic slots (Areas of Inquiry, general electives, CSS electives) are transcribed with their printed wording as choice slots; the map names no individual courses for them, so they list no options. No course prerequisites are recorded because the map prints none.
